name: Science fair research across many sites
notes: The climate science fair project spans thirteen tabs on almost thirteen different hosts (NASA, EPA, NOAA, IPCC, Our World in Data, Google Scholar, Science Buddies, wikiHow, Pinterest, YouTube). Shared words are sparse: 'climate', 'ocean acidification', 'science fair', 'CO2'. This is the hardest kind of context for a word-based sorter.
Learning piano (six tabs) and choosing a laptop (six tabs) are separate, smaller activities.
The Yamaha piano on Sweetwater belongs to piano, not to any shop grouping.
Five background tabs go to Misc.
